_readme: Calls U-A to U-D and Q1 to Q5 of WP-GW's U-34 run on revision 8 (2026-10-12; docs/status/WP-GW.md, 'U-34, the counters and the person quota'), for tests/usage-cache-estimate.test.ts. The usage counts are the ones recorded from each response. The prompts were synthetic: a system prompt of 190 lines of one template, each line ending with a 12-character random hex salt that differs per prefix, and one user message. The salts were not recorded, so the tests rebuild each prompt with a placeholder salt of the same length: character counts are exact, token counts are the recorded ones. U-A, U-B and U-C share prefix p1; U-D has its own prefix p2; each Q call has its own uncached prefix.
minCacheableTokensSource: Anthropic 'Prompt caching', Cache limitations: 4,096 tokens for Claude Haiku 4.5, on Microsoft Foundry too (retrieved 2026-10-12)

prefix.template: Reference line {n}: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the gateway counts tokens for cache test {salt}.

userMessage: Reply with the single word: ok
